name: ais-03-callsign-only-to-type5
reference: No lat or lon, so position-a1 and every other kind before static-voyage fail their requires; static-voyage requires ais.mmsi and callsign. Call sign 'PBXY' + 3 x @ at bits 70-111; ship name and destination absent, zero bits (20 x @); ETA hour 24, minute 60 and dte 1 from the defaults; everything else zero. L = 424, 71 characters with 2 zero fill bits.
